channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The chip vendors are now financing the compute they sell. On Tuesday Nvidia said it will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering and AMD $1 billion, and Meta priced the deal upsized: $25 billion of common stock at $625 a share plus $12.5 billion of 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred, $37.5 billion in all. Meta will add Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and Spectrum-X networking, and has AMD Helios racks installed and in testing with a custom MI450 to come. The same morning Naver signed a contract for up to $9 billion of GPUs and data centres through a Brookfield-funded vehicle, which meets the condition for Nvidia's $1 billion equity investment in Naver. Buyers with balance sheets or revenue outside AI get equity and structured leases. Standalone neoclouds pay for credit: CoreWeave's default insurance costs more than twice what it did in June. On the public tape, all 70 list prints confirmed with no changes.

item.title: Compute brief - 27 October 2026
item.description: The chip vendors are now financing the compute they sell. On Tuesday Nvidia said it will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering and AMD $1 billion, and Meta priced the deal upsized: $25 billion of common stock at $625 a share plus $12.5 billion of 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred, $37.5 billion in all. Meta will add Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and Spectrum-X networking, and has AMD Helios racks installed and in testing with a custom MI450 to come. The same morning Naver signed a contract for up to $9 billion of GPUs and data centres through a Brookfield-funded vehicle, which meets the condition for Nvidia's $1 billion equity investment in Naver. Buyers with balance sheets or revenue outside AI get equity and structured leases. Standalone neoclouds pay for credit: CoreWeave's default insurance costs more than twice what it did in June. On the public tape, all 70 list prints confirmed with no changes. Countries: South Korea: Naver signs up to $9 billion Brookfield compute vehicle; Nvidia $1 billion equity investment proceeds; 55 MW in 1H 2027, 200 MW by 2028 (Wire, 27 Oct). Malaysia: Anwar says SoftBank plans $50 billion of AI and data centre investment in Kuching, Sarawak and the peninsula; SoftBank has not commented (Wire, 24 Oct). Paraguay: Crusoe and Araico plan AI cloud capacity at the Itaipú substation from mid-2027, path to 106 MW and options to about 280 MW (Wire, 22 Oct). Denmark: CoreWeave brings most of 22.5 MW online at atNorth DEN01 in Copenhagen on Blackwell (Wire, 27 Oct). Kazakhstan: Freedom Holding advances a $2 billion, 100 MW Sovereign AI Hub; first public GPU cloud in 2027 (Wire, 26 Oct).
